external_collaboration.evidence_quote: IFB is a member of the American Farm Bureau Federation® (AFBF), organized in 1919 and recognized as the unified national voice of agriculture. Today, IFB is a proud leader in Illinois’ largest industry and gives members an advantage through impactful advocacy, trusted information and meaningful development.

Throughout our history, IFB has also supported the formation of key agricultural companies, including COUNTRY Financial, GROWMARK and FS, Prairie Farms Dairy and others, helping strengthen the infrastructure that supports Illinois agriculture.
